certified_ihs_under_budget.description: Certified pseudo-Boolean optimisation through counted oracles on held-out generated instances: how many instances a solver certifies optimal within a budget of oracle calls, and how many calls certification takes. The instance constraints are visible only through the harness's decision oracle; lower bounds come only from the harness's exact hitting-set oracle.
certified_ihs_under_budget.rank_reference: Rank of a submission = weight * sum over metrics of coefficient * (submission value - reference value). The reference value is the proposed `sis_sls` row of scoring/scores_test.json (reference method, seed offset 0). The rows with coefficient 0 are diagnostics and do not enter the rank.
certified_ihs_under_budget.scaling_note: The `results` below are the paper's own numbers: the fraction of its 1786 PB-competition benchmark instances solved within 1 h and 14 GB (Table 1, single-solver SIS: 672 solved; Table 2, SIS with SLS: +13, i.e. 685). The gym is scaled down: generated network-activation instances with 24-52 objective variables, a pure-Python oracle harness standing in for RoundingSat, and an oracle-call budget (180 calls to count as solved, hard cap 720) instead of wall-clock time. Gym values are therefore not expected to equal these fractions; only the direction (SLS-integrated SIS solves more than plain SIS) is the reproduced claim.

certified_solve_rate.description: Fraction of held-out instances that the harness itself certifies optimal (its best feasible cost from the decision oracle equals its best lower bound from the exact hitting-set oracle) within 180 oracle calls. Every instance is in the denominator; anything uncertified counts as unsolved. Analogue of the paper's number of instances solved within the resource limit.

mean_call_ratio.description: Mean over held-out instances of (oracle calls the harness answered until it certified the instance) / 180; an instance not certified within the hard cap of 720 calls counts as 720/180 = 4. Machine-independent efficiency of certified solving, the quantity the paper uses to explain its hybrids (fewer oracle calls).

mean_decide_calls.description: Diagnostic (not ranked): mean decision-oracle calls per instance, as counted by the harness.

mean_hs_calls.description: Diagnostic (not ranked): mean exact hitting-set oracle calls per instance, as counted by the harness.

hs_call_share.description: Diagnostic (not ranked): exact hitting-set oracle calls as a share of all oracle calls, as counted by the harness.
